en-US.name: Home Assistant
en-US.summary: Ask your circle about its calendar, vacations, and reminders.
en-US.description: A private skill for a Jarvis circle. Ask what's on the calendar, when the next vacation is, for trip details and flight times, set reminders, and message the group. Requires account linking to your Jarvis account; only members of a circle can use it.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask home assistant what's on our calendar today
Alexa, ask home assistant when our next vacation is
Alexa, ask home assistant to tell me about the Banff trip

publishingInformation.testingInstructions: Account-link to a Jarvis user that belongs to a circle, then ask the example phrases.
